shared_or_similar_visual_information: Matching chevron-shaped arrow marks drawn inside a pair of line segments.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: The matching arrow marks state that SR and PQ are parallel. Right image: The matching double-arrow marks state that the upper and lower sides are parallel.
Rationales: The arrow marks are repeated on two separate sides within each image, which is the geometric convention for parallel lines. Their purpose is a parallelism relation, irrespective of single versus double chevrons.
